Se quiser mudar de sede após concluir a inscrição, **escreva-nos por e-mail**. **ATTENTION**: This is an FMC competition with multiple locations. In order to make the organisers' job easier, you must write which location you will be attending in the registration comments. **Registrations without a specified location WILL NOT BE APPROVED**. We also recommend that you check your location's competitor limit. If you want to change your location once you have registered, **please email us**.
